body:
## Hotfix v2.0.3 - F10/F11 Diagnostics

### Added
- Diagnostic logging to identify why F10/F11 hotkeys don't respond
- Logging shows which input system works (Legacy vs New Input System)
- One-time startup diagnostic in Update() to verify MonoBehaviour lifecycle

### Fixed
- Spectator mode: disable colliders when entering, re-enable when exiting
- Currency sync: calculate delta from current amount to prevent desync
- Added ExitSpectatorMode() method

### Changed
- Improved UDP host note in menu
- Enhanced packet ordering comments

**IMPORTANT:** After launching the game, check BepInEx/LogOutput.log for [Coop] diagnostic messages that will help identify the F10/F11 issue.
name: v2.0.3 - F10/F11 Diagnostics
